title: Inter top scorers since 2000
brief: Name the ten players with the most Serie A goals for Inter since the start of 2000/01.

notes.Alvaro Recoba: Alvaro Recoba is just outside with 40 goals.

checks: Goals summed by Transfermarkt player id from every club season page; each club season checked against the table goals for (club_season_checks.csv). Each figure re-added from the player's own Transfermarkt game log, and from the season-by-season club table in the player's English Wikipedia article (Serie A seasons 2000/01 to 2025/26 only).
